profile_text.body:
Unisys is a global technology solutions company, describing itself as serving cloud, AI, digital workplace, applications and enterprise computing. Its site presents AI advisory, solution development and scalable infrastructure alongside change management work, and says it helps customers modernize legacy applications, migrate to cloud environments including AWS, Azure and Google, and build cloud-native systems. It also describes agentic AI-driven service desk support, field services and device subscription offerings.

On AI specifically, the company frames its pitch around moving customers from pilots to measurable results and around responsible adoption. It points to an AI & Cloud Insights Report 2026, peer-reviewed quantum computing research from its team covering optimization, machine learning, financial services and precision medicine, and commentary from CEO Mike Thomson on why AI governance should not wait for policy. The site notes that some of its content may be created or assisted by AI and that it reviews content for accuracy without guaranteeing it is free of errors or omissions.

Unisys is a public company traded under the ticker UIS and registered with the SEC under CIK 0000746838. The record holds no litigation, no tracked products and no MCP servers for the company.
